Stage 0 review, final experiments and scope freeze memo, Section 3 (secondary metric)

STAGE0.guide_decision: Ma'am, Stage 0 review memo, 12 Oct 2026: not an alignment problem (the intercept drifts between refits); Stage 0b, the anomaly sensitivity and Task 4 go ahead, Task 4 with anomaly rho as a pre-specified secondary metric

PURPOSE: show that the protocol detects a genuine advantage when one exists, does not manufacture one when none exists, and has an empirical minimum detectable delta rho at n = 16
PROTOCOL: unchanged from v1.4 / Task 3: T0 = min(10, max(5, n // 3)), embargo g = 6, fold size 1, fold-local statistics truncated at the test day, purge rule, RF settings (ndi.CONFIG RF_PARAMS, n_jobs = 1), F_SCALE 1.0, seed rules. Code: CELL 14.4, V12-1, V12-2 and the T3-1 wrapper executed from the Task 3 notebook under tag v1.4-task3 (hashes below). The only substitution: get_folds returns the folds of ndi.blocked_tscv without fitting a forest per fold (fold check).
ARMS_REASON: the power curve is for V3 vs raw-RF (v1.3 memo); other arms add cost only

GENERATOR.source: Arm 2, CELL C2.0 and CELL C2.1 of the v1 notebook, verbatim (two-state latent Markov process, participant intercepts, injected missingness and flatlines)

COHORT.pid_format: <cell>_r<replicate, 3+ digits>_p<01-16>, e.g. C1b2_r037_p05 (unique per cell and replicate, so no cache entry can be shared)

OUTCOME.alignment: next_day (Task 3's code): row s is scored against Y_{s+1}; target support {s + 1}; the purge removes nothing (asserted for every replicate); the last row has no next day
OUTCOME.model: Y_{s+1} = beta * S_s + eps_{s+1}, eps ~ N(0, 1) independent over participant-days
OUTCOME.C0: no signal (beta = 0): Y independent of everything
OUTCOME.C1: S = z(v_t - v_pop): v_t = causal volatility as the F channel reads it (expanding SD of the observed series over days <= t, min_periods = 3, NaN skipped); v_pop = population volatility norm of CELL 14.4 (median of the other 15 participants' whole-series SDs), the norm F uses
OUTCOME.C2: S = z(x_t): the observed raw feature level on day t
OUTCOME.z: over all participant-days of the cohort where the quantity is defined (mean, SD with ddof 0); days where it is undefined (x_t missing; fewer than 3 observations for v_t) get S = 0
OUTCOME.common_random_numbers: cohort data and eps depend only on the replicate r: numpy default_rng([ARM2_SEED, r]) for the cohort (participants generated in order p01..p16) and default_rng([ARM2_SEED, r, 1]) for eps. Every cell of replicate r has the same cohort and eps; only S and beta change. Never depends on the machine or shard.

CALIBRATION.oracle_definition: mean over participants of Spearman(S_s, Y_{s+1}) on the scored test days
CALIBRATION.grid: beta = 0 and 301 log-spaced values 0.001..1000, then bisection; beta rounded to 6 significant digits

EXTENSION.rule: runs automatically with the same replicate count if the power of C1b3 (highest main C1 level) is below 0.80 at P < .0125 -- i.e. at either threshold -- so both MDEs can be estimated; nothing else may be added after results are seen

REPLICATE_RULE: 100 per cell; 200 only if the full-run machine has 16 or more physical cores (Task 3 review memo, Section 3). The machine is confirmed by ma'am after this tag (Stage 0 review memo, Section 3), so the count is fixed at the value above; any change would be a new config and tag before the full run
FULL_RUN_MACHINE: to be confirmed by ma'am (Stage 0 review memo, Section 3); pilot on Google Colab

PILOT.note: the full run recomputes these replicates in results_task4/cells; merge asserts they are identical (determinism across sessions)

SECONDARY_METRIC.name: anomaly rho (pre-specified secondary metric; Stage 0 review memo, Section 3)
SECONDARY_METRIC.definition: for every scored test day s, a(s) = mean of the target over the training rows that day's fold uses (run_arms' loop: embargo check, purge, finite-target rows, >= 5 rows); rho_anom = Spearman(f(s) - a(s), y(s) - a(s)) per participant over the scored test days, for each arm, from the same predictions
SECONDARY_METRIC.recorded: per participant v3_anom and rawrf_anom; per replicate the same decision statistics as the primary metric with prefix anom_ (two-sided paired Wilcoxon P, mean delta, direction, significance at P < .05 and P < .0125)
SECONDARY_METRIC.reported: power per cell (Wilson 95% CI) and MDE (probit, bootstrap CI), as for the primary metric; the primary metric stays primary; the extension rule and the reading of C0 / C2 use the primary metric

DECISION_RULE: per replicate: two-sided paired Wilcoxon (scipy.stats.wilcoxon(v3, rawrf), defaults, as Task 1) on V3 vs raw-RF across the participants with both rho finite; record P, mean delta rho, both arms' mean rho; significant at P < .05 (optimistic) and at P < .0125 (conservative: the strictest threshold BH could apply across four comparisons). Direction = the larger signed-rank sum.

POWER.C1: proportion of replicates significant in V3's favour
POWER.C2: proportion significant in raw-RF's favour; V3 win rate (significant in V3's favour) reported against 0.05
POWER.C0: false-positive rate = proportion significant in either direction (and per direction)
POWER.mc_se: mean delta rho and arm means with Monte Carlo SE = SD / sqrt(R)

MDE.points: C0 and the C1 levels (with C1b4 if it ran): x = cell mean delta rho, y = proportion significant in V3's favour
MDE.fit: probit (binomial maximum likelihood), 80% crossing, at each threshold
MDE.ci: bootstrap over replicates within each cell, 2,000 resamples, seed 42, percentile 95%
MDE.fallback: if the observed power at the highest C1 level is below 0.80: 'MDE above delta rho = <that level's mean delta rho>' (no extrapolation)

READING: C0: false-positive rate should be at or below 0.05; its Wilson CI is reported either way
C1: the MDE is the delta rho at which the protocol detects V3's advantage 80% of the time with 16 participants, set against the upper 95% bounds of the real comparisons (0.132 and 0.076)
C2: raw-RF should match or beat V3; a V3 win rate above 0.05 means the protocol favours the index
if C1 never reaches 80% even at the extension level, the report is 'MDE above delta rho = [value]'
FIGURE5: power curves for C1 and C2 (both thresholds, Wilson 95% CI), C0 false-positive rate marked, probit fits, MDEs, the real upper bounds as reference lines
